units.source_text: 本回继前回之后，写薰大将二十八岁五月之事。

en.t: This chapter follows the previous one and tells of events in the fifth month when Commander Kaoru was twenty-eight years old.

units.source_text: 回名“梦浮桥”三字，在本回文中并未提及，想是将此长篇故事比作梦中浮桥之意。

en.t: The three characters of the chapter title, Dream Floating Bridge, are not mentioned in the text of this chapter; they likely mean to compare this long tale to a floating bridge in a dream.

units.source_text: 又，本回别名“法师”，乃根据回末薰君的诗。

en.t: Also, this chapter's alternate title, The Monk, is based on Lord Kaoru's poem at the end of the chapter.
